The four XYZ files list the gold-nanoparticle centres (nm) of model crystallites of DNA-linked gold-nanoparticle superlattices assembled with four different duplex DNA linkers; each file is named after its linker and was built from that linker's published SAXS unit-cell size. You must choose one linker for a new superlattice such that the nearest-neighbour spacing is as large as possible while at least 1.0 % of the volume is gold (solid gold cores of diameter 10.3 nm; perfect infinite lattice). Which linker should you choose?

选项：
A. 39-linker (Au-FCC-39-linker.xyz)
B. X-linker (Au-FCC-X-linker.xyz)
C. 13-linker (Au-FCC-13-linker.xyz)
D. 26-linker (Au-FCC-26-linker.xyz)

附件：Au-FCC-X-linker.xyz、Au-FCC-13-linker.xyz、Au-FCC-26-linker.xyz、Au-FCC-39-linker.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文表 1 的 SAXS 晶胞边长构建的理想 FCC 晶粒模型（粒子中心，约 177 个，经确定性旋转）；不是实测粒子坐标，不含位置无序与峰宽。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
